name: Fleet Mutineer
desc: One of your own people, armed, and sure that they're doing the right thing.

intro: Someone you've seen in the mess hall raises a sidearm, and tells you it doesn't have to go like this, Captain.
A crew member with a strip of red cloth tied around one arm steps into the corridor, and says the fleet deserves a better captain than you.
hit: The shot hits you, and the mutineer flinches as if it had gone the other way.
"You left them out there!" they shout at you, and they fire again, and it lands.
They know your drills, because you're the one who ordered them, and they get there first.
miss: The shot goes wide of you. Their hands are shaking, and you know they've never aimed at a captain before.
You know that firing stance from your own training manuals, and you're out of the way before the round arrives.
They call your name and fire, and the round sparks off the bulkhead behind you.
crit: They've served on your ship long enough to know exactly where you stand when you're tired, and the shot finds you there.
defeated: The mutineer slides down the bulkhead, looks up at you, and asks you to tell their family they weren't a traitor.
They drop the sidearm and salute you, out of pure habit, and then look ashamed of it.
joins: {Enemy} comes around the corner with a sidearm up, and you recognize the face.
stunned: {Enemy} hesitates with the sidearm half raised, and can't quite point it at you.
persuade_worked: You say the names of the people on the ship they're trying to save, and you tell them what happens to those people if this goes on. They lower the weapon, and they don't look at you.
persuade_failed: You tell them it doesn't have to go this way. They say that's what the last captain said.
